title: LoopLearn
description: LoopLearn delivers daily bite-sized learning for developers, covering topics from cybersecurity, frontend, and backend with concept explanations and real-world case studies.

title: Passkey
description: A secure password generator and password manager featuring encryption/decryption and Google authentication for passwordless login.

title: Vibexx
description: Generates personalized Spotify playlists based on the user’s mood. Detects emotions using webcam image processing and syncs playlists directly to the user’s Spotify account.

title: GameLobby

title: FormGen
description: A Python package that auto-generates full React forms using JSON. Eliminates repetitive form boilerplate and speeds up development.
